description: This file defines the class InstrumentationTargetPackageConverter, which provides conversion and reference resolution logic for Android manifest package attributes within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: InstrumentationTargetPackageConverter
classes.description: A converter class for Android manifest package attribute references, implementing conversion and reference resolution logic.

classes.name: MyReference
classes.description: Inner class extending PsiReferenceBase, responsible for resolving package attribute references within Android modules.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Returns the input string as-is; used for converting from string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the input string as-is; used for converting to string representation.

methods.name: createReferences
methods.description: Creates PSI references for a given DOM value and PSI element, returning an array with a custom reference if applicable.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the reference to the corresponding PSI element, utilizing caching.

methods.name: resolveInner
methods.description: Performs the internal logic to resolve the package attribute to a PSI element by matching values in module dependencies.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Provides possible package attribute value variants from module dependencies.

methods.name: processApkPackageAttrs
methods.description: Processes Android module dependencies to find and process package attributes.
